title: Lead Backend Developer (Mobile APIs)
text:
Demo Co. Elm is a startup building media apps. We are looking for a lead-level Backend Developer (Mobile APIs) to join our mobile team. Work is on-site in our Eastmere office.

Our stack: kotlin, go, csharp. You will improve app performance and stability, own the release process and work closely with design and product.

Regular hack days. You will mentor less experienced colleagues.
